a callee whose declared (locked) return points at something other than void/unknown declines

joins_other_values: the value and its COPY/CAST closure must reach no MULTIEQUAL/INDIRECT, must not sit in address-tied storage or in the phi-joined return register (mark_output_storage_addr_tied ties it later; a locked member decides a merged variable's type -- wordsplit_add_segm/parse_transform_expr/Pexecute returned struct_N * before this rule: 11/36 wrong return types -> 0/11)
a base whose every access stores a constant whose bytes read as text is a string buffer (constant_text; tar SCHILY.xattr.)

under locals a function asks its widest layout first, so its own later layout never supersedes an earlier answer: without it a --jobs 8 run on tar O2 fell back to one ordered worker (15.2 s -> 26.0 s); with it the pool renames in place (109 renamed, 10 redone) with output identical to serial
